Task instruction: Pick the compact hamburg box and the golden crispy fries inside red box, then place them on the tray for carrying items.

Success criteria: Both boxes are on the tray, each horizontally close to its designated placement position, and both grippers are open. The material does not identify the specific alignment points on the boxes or the target positions within the tray, so these cannot be assumed to be the tray center or fixed left/right sections.

## Execution tips

- Grip the flatter areas on opposite sides of the burger box body, avoiding the lid seam and corners as much as possible. Set the gripper opening slightly wider than the grasped section to reduce catching the lid edge or brushing nearby objects.
- Grip the fries box on both sides of the red body below the protruding fries so the pads contact the box wall fully. Avoid the opening and fries to reduce slipping.
- Before closing, use a side view if possible to confirm both fingers are on opposite sides of the box body and the pads have enough contact area, rather than merely overlapping in the image or grasping only a corner.
- Leave height clearance under the box when crossing the raised tray rim. Let the tray support it before release, leaving room for fingers to open between the box, rim, and other box to reduce collisions and drops.
